# Oktay Kırık — app websites

> Official product, privacy, license, and support pages for independent apps published by Oktay Kırık.

Floe is a native window manager for Mac. Its product details, requirements,
download, and current trial and purchasing conditions are summarized in the
Floe context file linked below. Product pages are published by the developer.

## Floe for Mac

- [Floe product context](https://oktykrk.github.io/floe/llms.txt): A concise text overview and links to official product information.
- [Floe website](https://oktykrk.github.io/floe/): Window snapping, tiling, Snap Assist, custom layouts, and shared resizing.

## Optional

- [Publisher](https://oktykrk.github.io/): Oktay Kırık's application portfolio.
- [Cadreur](https://oktykrk.github.io/video-take/): Teleprompter and video studio for iPhone and iPad. Write, record in sections, edit, and caption; three projects free.
- [Pado PDF](https://oktykrk.github.io/pado-pdf/): Official application and support pages.

- [MediaRoll](https://oktykrk.github.io/media-roll/): Native photo, video, and audio viewer for macOS 14+. Open one file and browse supported media in the same folder. Compare, crop, and export. Coming to the Mac App Store; 30-day free trial, then an optional one-time Lifetime Unlock.

- [PlainShot](https://oktykrk.github.io/plain-shot/): A screenshot and annotation app for macOS 14+. Region, window, and desktop capture; 10 tools; permanent local PNG history. No PlainShot account, cloud uploads, or telemetry. Coming soon for Mac; 30-day trial and an optional one-time Permanent Unlock.
